prospects.thesis: Leidos combines the highest composite score with bullish signals across options, institutional flow, and strong 1M momentum (+31.8%), all at a very reasonable 1.0x P/S — rare for a defense prime with meaningful AI/digital modernization exposure. The company benefits from sustained DoD IT modernization spend, classified program growth, and expanding health/civil segments. Entry is attractive as defense tech continues re-rating alongside geopolitical tensions and FY27 budget visibility.

SMCI is the cleanest pure-play on AI server/rack buildouts with direct exposure to Blackwell and liquid-cooling deployments at hyperscalers, yet trades at just 0.6x P/S — a massive discount to peers. Bullish options and institutional signals plus +21.9% 1M momentum suggest smart money is re-engaging after last year's accounting overhang cleared. Provides semiconductor theme diversification without overlapping existing NVDA/MU/MRVL exposure.

GitLab's Duo AI-assisted DevSecOps platform is monetizing well as enterprises consolidate toolchains, and the company is one of the few software names with clear seat-expansion AI revenue attach. At 7.0x P/S with +32.9% 1M momentum and bullish options/institutional flow, it offers AI software exposure distinct from infra plays like MDB or SNOW. Near-term catalyst is the upcoming Q2 print where Duo Enterprise attach rates should inflect.

UiPath is emerging as the leading agentic automation platform, bridging RPA with generative AI agents — a differentiated sub-niche from developer tools (GTLB) or data platforms. The +53.2% 1M rip on bullish options and institutional flow signals a turnaround inflection after several quarters of reset guidance, and 5.1x P/S remains undemanding. Catalyst: agentic AI product cycle plus renewed enterprise ARR growth.

Kratos offers unmanned/autonomous systems exposure (tactical drones, hypersonics, satellite comms) that complements the traditional services angle of LDOS — a distinct defense sub-niche tied directly to the Replicator initiative and CCA drone programs. Bullish institutional positioning and +19.4% 1M momentum reflect growing conviction in production ramp. Premium 7.0x P/S is justified by the highest growth profile in the defense cohort.
